sources.author: Darkaxt
patch_list: Fix 4:3 / Foldable Book & Drawing UI Scaling

Scales the Book, Thoughts, Book Shelf, and Drawing overlays to 0.75x on narrow (< 1.4) aspect ratios instead of 1.05x so menus fit cleanly inside the full-screen 4:3 stone HUD border without shrinking the game into a 16:9 letterbox.
Aligns Scene 13's Intro Camera viewport to the centered 16:9 stone frame on narrow (< 1.75) aspect ratios so the starting intro animation is no longer cropped on the left and right edges.
Switches VideoPlayer from FitVertically to FitInside so cutscenes, dreams, and ending videos never crop horizontally on 4:3 tablets, foldables, or ultrawides.
Removes permanent aspect-ratio caching in GetAspectRatio() so folding or unfolding mid-session immediately updates camera zoom, room borders, HUD, and UI scaling.
